name: awakened
description: Awakened - a curated, synthesized Claude Code plugin marketplace: nine plugins rebuilt from the strongest open-source Claude Code repositories with the bloat, risk, and friction engineered out.

plugins.name: super-saiyan
plugins.description: Core engineering workflow: planning, implementation discipline, test-driven development, systematic debugging, verification before completion, and git workflow guidance. The stable baseline - it depends on no agents, memory infrastructure, or project-specific tooling (B-1).

plugins.name: sharingan
plugins.description: Code review and analysis: review discipline, production audit, architecture inspection, AI-debt detection, and security-oriented review. Analysis and review only - implementation stays outside this plugin (B-2).

plugins.name: rinnegan
plugins.description: Persistent temporal memory: file-based decision history, session context, searchable project notes, and recall across sessions. No daemons, workers, databases, or services (B-3).

plugins.name: kaioken
plugins.description: Session management and momentum: save and resume sessions, handoffs, checkpoints, and focused asides. Session momentum only - it duplicates no planning, debugging, or review system (B-5).

plugins.name: bankai
plugins.description: Specialist subagents with restricted tool allowlists: research, exploration, debugging, review, planning, documentation, and synthesis agents, plus the skills that dispatch them. Every subagent in Awakened lives here (B-6).

plugins.name: domain
plugins.description: Project-scoped structural context: codebase onboarding, code maps, documentation upkeep, conventions, domain modeling, and CLAUDE.md scaffolding. Structural context only; it stores no history (B-4).

plugins.name: instinct
plugins.description: Marketplace meta tooling: skill creation, writing for agents, context budgeting, skill scouting, component auditing, and linting. Marketplace maintenance, not user workflow execution (B-7).

plugins.name: poneglyph
plugins.description: Optional Obsidian knowledge-vault integration: Obsidian Markdown, the Obsidian CLI, Bases, and JSON Canvas. A satellite - never a dependency of any core plugin (B-8).

plugins.name: aura
plugins.description: Optional personalization: statusline presets as cross-platform script twins, colour palettes, and output styles. Original Awakened work with zero dependencies; a satellite, never a core dependency (B-8).
